extDescription.message: Dark mode for every website, with per-site rules, scheduling and no tracking.

cmdToggleSite.message: Toggle dark mode on the current site

cmdToggleGlobal.message: Turn the extension on or off everywhere

cmdCycleMode.message: Cycle mode on the current site (dark, filtered, normal)

unsupportedPageHint.message: Browser pages and extension stores don't allow extensions to restyle them.

suppressed_disabled.message: Turned off everywhere. Use the power button to turn it back on.

suppressed_allowlist.message: Allowlist mode: this site isn't on your list.

suppressed_automation.message: Off right now because of your automation setting.

sectionIntegration.message: Sites with their own dark theme

defaultMode.message: Mode for sites without a rule

list_blocklist.message: Every site except those I turn off

listHint_blocklist.message: Sites are converted unless a rule turns them off.

listHint_allowlist.message: Only sites with a rule that sets a mode are changed.

integrationDefault.message: When a site has its own dark theme

syncSettings.message: Sync settings with this browser account

syncHint.message: Turning sync on loads settings saved by your other browsers, if there are any.

syncError_too_large.message: Your settings are too large to sync. Remove some custom CSS to sync again.

syncError_quota.message: The browser refused to sync (too many changes). It will retry on the next change.

sitesHint.message: More specific rules win: site, then subdomain, then pattern, then page.

noRules.message: No rules yet. Rules you set from the popup appear here.

pdfEnabled.message: Open PDFs in the dark viewer

importConfirm.message: Replace all current settings with the imported ones?

importError_unknown_format.message: This file format is not supported. Night Eye has no documented export format yet.

integrationNoChanges.message: None. We have not saved anything on any site.

integrationUndoHint.message: These are undone the next time you open the site after choosing Convert anyway or Leave it alone, or turning dark mode off for it.

forgetDarkSites.message: Forget sites detected as already dark

privacyShort.message: No data leaves your browser. Nothing is collected or sent, and there are no analytics.
